FINDER F4b, PART 1b OF 3: SELECTION, OVERLAY AND INSPECT ROUND TRIP, ON THIS BRANCH. Part 1a is already on this branch (commit a2e289e5): the picker, ranked cards, paging, the selected=<id64> URL selection, the retained selected point, and the shared navigation helper apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/navigation.ts (navigateWithAnchor, readExploreAnchor, inspectHref). Build on them; do not rework part 1a's files except where a change below needs it, and say why if you do.

AUTHORITY: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md, section 8 "PR F4b" (the file list and its paragraphs), section 5 "Inspect, map and later weight pop-out", section 6 (State and URL contract), and section 7 (Unit tests; Svelte component tests). The main sections govern where a review-round entry differs.

PART 1b SCOPE, from the F4b list:
1. apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts and client.test.ts: getSystem normalizes the legacy all-zero coordinate triple (0, 0, 0) to absent coordinates unless the id64 is Sol (10477373803), the canonical origin guard of section 5, so every consumer inherits it. Tests: a non-Sol system returning (0, 0, 0) yields no point while the selection is retained; Sol itself yields the point.
2. apps/web/src/lib/components/AppShell.svelte, plus new AppShell.test.ts and AppShellTestHost.svelte: reactive selection hydration from page.url on every navigation and popstate, with independent semantics: selected=<id64> is the URL-owned passive selection; system=<id64> stays exclusively the explicit SystemOverlay/Inspect trigger. Closing the overlay removes only system; clearing selection removes only selected; on /explore, omitting selected clears the URL-owned selection.
3. apps/web/src/lib/components/SystemOverlay.svelte and SystemOverlay.test.ts: the close path goes through navigateWithAnchor so the entry keeps page.state (the anchor payload). Test: open and close the overlay on an anchored search, and assert that the anchor, its coordinates and the 500-LY request survive.
4. apps/web/src/routes/inspect/+page.svelte, plus new +page.test.ts and InspectPageTestHost.svelte (the QueryClientProvider host that the mounted SystemDetail needs): in enabled builds, Open in Explore replays the originating from query, deletes any prior or duplicate selected and system, sets each once to the inspected id64, and carries page.state; Back to Explore (today a plain link to /explore) replays from and carries page.state through the same helper without adding the selection; with no from, both fall back to today's behaviour. Tests: the default-off build keeps today's links unchanged; the enabled replay; the bare-link fallback; and a Back to Explore round trip that restores the archetype, floor, page and anchor without selecting the inspected system.
5. apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/WatchlistPanel.svelte and WatchlistPanel.test.ts: its two live /inspect?system= links use inspectHref and navigateWithAnchor, so they carry from and the outbound page.state. Focused round-trip tests for both links.

GATE: everything new stays behind the existing default-off VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED gate. With the gate off, current behaviour and all existing tests must pass unchanged.

LEAVE FOR PART 2, do not edit: apps/web/Dockerfile, .github/workflows/, apps/web/cypress/, apps/api/, scripts/, tests/ (Python), CHANGES.md and docs/. Do not change API code or generated clients.

CHECKS TO RUN in apps/web with Node 24 and pnpm 11.25.0: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm test, pnpm build. Do not run Cypress.

FINAL ANSWER: list every changed file with one line each; list every place where you had to interpret the design, with the section you relied on; and give the check results with test counts.
